dct_description_sm: 2 bar scales on map, given in “Stadia Sinensia” and “Milliaria Germanica.”
Latitudinal and longitudinal lines along margins.
Key in upper left: Notarum explicatio.
“Cum privilegio S. C. M. & Ordd. Belg. Fœder.”
Appears in Blaeu's Novus Atlas Sinensis, Amsterdam, 1655.
This copy has pencil inscription in lower left: 201B.
